name: Chimney Fire  ( Seeley-Marjerison)
peak: All Winter Ice Routes - Chimney Pond & other Sub-Areas
text: [overview] A lengthy, easy, meandering ice pitch follows, then a snowfield, steep at first and then easing, leads to a cave called the Lunch Ledge, below Pamola IV's ridge.
[overview] mixed ground and steep snow for a stretch of a couple of hundred feet ends where it turns hard left onto the far end of Pamola IV's ridge.

name: The Diamond
peak: All Winter Ice Routes - Chimney Pond & other Sub-Areas
text: [overview] Surmount the first ice flow, or slip in via the slabby ice or steep snow on the looker's right, then climb steep snow up to the thin stepped ice.
[overview] A further narrow gully of snow higher up gives a simple mixed finish.
